text:
The artistic concept centers on the "Circle of Resonance," a multimedia installation that honors the Native American pow-wow as a living vessel for cultural continuity. The design features a central circular stage where dancers move in rhythmic counter-clockwise motion, symbolizing the sun’s path and the cyclical nature of life. Surrounding the stage are suspended, translucent panels displaying intricate beadwork patterns that mirror the geometric precision of traditional regalia. These patterns are illuminated from within, casting shadows that mimic the movement of feather headdresses swaying in the wind. The soundscape is built from layered recordings of drumbeats and singing, creating an immersive auditory experience that connects viewers to the communal spirit of the gathering. The footwear elements are represented by textured floor materials that change underfoot, inviting participants to feel the connection to the earth. This concept aims to preserve and celebrate the significance of these traditions while fostering a deeper understanding of their cultural weight.
